senses.gloss:
इभ इभ, अस् or अम्?, m. or n. ? (said to be
fr. rt. इ, to go), Ved. servants, dependants, domestics,
household, family; (Sāy.) fearless power; (अस्, आ, अम्),
followed by attendants; (अस्), m. an elephant; (ई),
f. a female elephant; [with this word cf. the Gr.
ἐλ-έφας and the Lat. ebur.]
—इभ-कणा, f. a plant
with an aromatic seed, Scindapsus Officinalis.
—इभ-
केशर, अस्, m. the tree Mesua Roxburghii.
—इभ-
गन्धा, f., N. of a poisonous fruit.
—इभ-दन्ता,
f. the plant Tiaridium Indicum.
—इभ-निमीलिका, f.
smartness, shrewdness, sagacity (like that of an ele-
phant).
—इभ-पालक, अस्, m. the driver or keeper
of an elephant.
—इभ-पोटा, f. a young elephant, a
cub.
—इभम्-आचल, अस्, m. a lion.
—इभ-युवति,
इस्, f. an elephant's cub.
—इभाख्य (˚भ-आख्˚),
अस्, m. the plant Mesua Roxburghii.
—इभारि (˚भ-
अर्˚), इस्, m. a lion (‘enemy of the elephant’).
—इभो-
षणा (˚भ-उष्˚), f. a kind of aromatic plant.
